svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Tambourine face (ASSUMED printable face diameter 150 mm - TBC)
svg.desc: Magenta = assumed printable face Ø150 mm (TBC); blue dashed = 3 mm bleed; green dotted = 5 mm recommended safe area; grey band = physical metal hoop shown in reference (not printed). | FOIL_GOLD layer = spot colour for metallic foil (display colour #A37A4E). FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
